name: Broken Samophlange
summary: In the northern Barrens, a broken samophlange has drawn curious engineers. Its shifting parts and fine gears still hint at a purpose no one has uncovered.

sections.title: A Baffling Mechanism
sections.body: From the northern Barrens comes a broken samophlange, its fine gears and moving assemblies still showing careful workmanship. Sputtervalve, a goblin in Ratchet, damaged the delicate device by accident before anyone could record how it worked. Hoping to send working results to curious colleagues in Undermine, its finder sought someone who could repair it. Wenikee Boltbucket, a clever tinkerer near Mor'shan Rampart, was the one they turned to.

sections.title: Seeking Tinkerer's Hands
sections.body: Wenikee Boltbucket cannot tell what a samophlange is meant to do, even after studying its ruined parts. Its clockwork sounds and shifting motion catch her interest. Rather than cast it aside as junk, she sets out to repair it and see its mechanisms working at full capacity.

faq.answer: Even the tinkerers trying to repair a samophlange cannot say what it does. Its name offers no answer, but its fine gears and moving parts point to some unknown industrial purpose.

Sputtervalve, a goblin in Ratchet, damaged the delicate machinery while tampering with the device brought to him. The samophlange seized before its secrets could be shared with colleagues in Undermine, so they sought an expert to set it working again.

Wenikee Boltbucket is an inquisitive tinkerer in the northern Barrens, just south of Mor'shan Rampart on the Ashenvale border. Her curiosity about engineering leads her to inspect and rebuild strange contraptions.

faq.q: Why are goblins in Undermine interested in it?
faq.answer: Goblin engineers and entrepreneurs are eager to study unusual mechanical devices. Word of the samophlange reached contacts in Undermine, who were intrigued by whatever advantages it might offer.

angles.text: For an engineer, the samophlange is an irresistible puzzle. Its delicate inner gears may reveal their purpose only when the machine is taken apart and set running.
The device turns up in Horde territory in the Barrens, bringing local outposts, tinkerers, and neutral trading contacts together.
